definitions: A long motor vehicle carrying passengers by road, especially for sightseeing or between towns.
A person who trains an athlete or a team.
A four-wheeled, horse-drawn carriage, especially one for passengers.
An economy-class seat in an aircraft or train.
examples: We took a coach to Edinburgh.
The football coach was very strict.
She hired a coach for her exams.
The old coach rattled down the lane.
